text: The authors recruited judges via Prolific with mainstream (scientific consensus) or skeptical views: for COVID-19, 68 qualified participants (34 per belief group) from 650 candidates, giving 448 consultancy and 448 debate sessions after quality filtering; for climate change, 146 participants (73 per group) from 1,000 candidates, giving 421 debate and 424 consultancy sessions.
title: Human judge recruitment by prior belief: 68 COVID-19 and 146 climate participants
